description: seed.apply is the explicit human door (via=explicit): it takes the set and the keys to scope the apply, writes through the engine, and stamps the actor from the CONNECTION (the daemon's ActorFor seam), never from params (S43-extra T6, SD10). The result is the per-record apply outcome (op, fromVersion/toVersion, reason) and requiresConfirmation:false — the daemon does not pretend a socket can prove a human is present; the confirmation is a UI/CLI concern (SD11, S45 PM7). A params actor would let a caller forge the audit identity, so it is refused by shape, never resolved.
